name: Google Workspace MFA Disabled
description: Google 2-step verification is the second factor on Workspace. Turning it off for a user, or for the whole org, makes a stolen password enough. Helpdesk sometimes disables it to recover a locked user. Attackers disable it to keep access. The difference is a ticket and a short window before it is turned back on. MFA off on admin users should page, not wait for a weekly review.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
